What We Design

Eight connected areas create a calm guest experience and a practical spa workflow.

01

Treatment Room Design

Private, comfortable rooms with considered storage, lighting and service access.

02

Relaxation Lounge

A quiet transition space for guests before and after each treatment.

03

Reception & Welcome Area

A warm arrival with clear check-in, waiting and product display zones.

04

Wet Areas

Steam, sauna and jacuzzi planning with safe, practical circulation.

05

Lighting & Ambience

Soft, layered light that supports calm without losing practical clarity.

06

Sound & Privacy Design

Acoustic separation and discreet movement between treatment and guest zones.

07

Material & Finish Selection

Stone, timber and calm palettes chosen for touch, durability and easy care.

08

Brand Styling & Décor

Subtle details that make the wellness experience recognisably yours.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take your wellness concept to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss treatments, guest profile, privacy, wet areas, brand and budget.

02

Site Measurement

We record the floor, services, ventilation, drainage and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Guest flow, treatment rooms and back-of-house needs form one calm plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Stone, timber, lighting and furniture are coordinated for comfort and care.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Drawings and 3D views prepare the spa for confident pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We provide an exact fixed quote after the survey, once the treatment rooms, wet areas and 3D package are clear.

Spa Design FAQs

Straight answers on calm, room capacity, wet areas, timing, branding and 3D approval.

We use quiet circulation, soft lighting, controlled acoustics and a restrained material palette to reduce visual and sensory noise.

Capacity depends on floor area, room type, storage, services and circulation. We test layouts before confirming the right number.

Yes. We plan wet zones around drainage, ventilation, waterproofing, privacy and safe guest movement.

A compact spa commonly takes three to four weeks. Larger wellness spaces with wet areas need more coordination time.

Yes. Materials, lighting, scent zones, signage and details are shaped around your brand in a quiet, natural way.

items.q: How does spa design create calm?
items.a: We use quiet circulation, soft lighting, controlled acoustics and a restrained material palette to reduce visual and sensory noise.

items.q: How many treatment rooms fit my space?
items.a: Capacity depends on floor area, room type, storage, services and circulation. We test layouts before confirming the right number.

items.q: Do you plan steam, sauna, and jacuzzi areas?
items.a: Yes. We plan wet zones around drainage, ventilation, waterproofing, privacy and safe guest movement.
A compact spa commonly takes three to four weeks. Larger wellness spaces with wet areas need more coordination time.

items.q: Can you match my wellness brand?
items.a: Yes. Materials, lighting, scent zones, signage and details are shaped around your brand in a quiet, natural way.

items.q: Do I get 3D visuals before execution?
items.a: Yes. Key treatment rooms, reception, lounge and wet areas are shown in 3D before site work begins.
